# web-mirror

> Rust command line tool and library that mirrors a section of a website to disk, like `wget --mirror`, with safe defaults: never goes above the start URL, never downloads a file twice, obeys robots.txt, and never writes outside the output directory.

Usage: `web-mirror [OPTIONS] [URL]`. Example: `web-mirror "https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/" --level 1 --link-selector main` saves the A–Z page and every page linked from its main content as `www.nhs.uk/conditions/.../index.html`. Exit codes: 0 success, 1 fatal error, 2 some URLs failed. Options are modeled on wget (`--wait`, `-l`, `-p`, `-k`, `-E`, `-H`/`-D`, `-A`/`-R`, `-N`, `--warc-file`, cookies), plus `--link-selector`, `--sitemap`, `--events` (JSON Lines), `--max-connections`/`--per-host`, `--config` (TOML), `--ignore-file`, and `--spider --check-external`; `web-mirror --help` lists them all and the specification defines each one.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, install, examples, options summary, library use
- [Specification](spec/index.md): exact behavior of every option, URL-to-file mapping, robots.txt, security guarantees, tests (single source of truth)
- [Compare wget](spec/compare/wget/index.md): wget options and their web-mirror equivalents
- [Benchmarks](spec/compare/benchmarks/index.md): web-mirror against wget on a local site, and how to reproduce
- [Compare tools](spec/compare/index.md): landscape of mirroring, fetching, spidering, and crawling tools, and web-mirror's gaps
- [Plan](plan.md): phased roadmap (all five phases done: offline copies, sitemaps, JSON events, WARC, resume, cookies, parallelism, conveniences)
- [Tasks](tasks.md): work items with acceptance criteria
- [Proposals](spec/proposals/index.md): proposed behavior (none open; every proposal is built)
- [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md): MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR BSD-3-Clause, at your option
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): conventions, commands, and security rules for contributors and AI agents

## Tests

- [Network tests must use ignore](spec/tests/integration-network-tests-must-use-ignore/index.md): rule for live-site tests
- [NHS conditions](spec/tests/www.nhs.uk/conditions/output.txt): expected files for `--level 1 --link-selector main`
- [NHS medicines](spec/tests/www.nhs.uk/medicines/output.txt): expected files for `--level 1 --link-selector main`
- [NHS mental health conditions](spec/tests/www.nhs.uk/mental-health/conditions/output.txt): expected files for `--level 1 --link-selector "main p"`

- [Cargo.toml](Cargo.toml): dependencies and minimum Rust version (1.99)
